enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Alarm rings. Open eyes.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Place plate on table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Close drawer. Put on socks. Pick up shoes. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pick up keys. Exit bedroom.
Exit home. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk to healthcare facility. Enter building.

Arrive at workstation. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Exit patient room. Wash hands. Enter next patient room. Check vital signs. Record data. Exit patient room. Wash hands. Take a break.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Stand up. Exit cafeteria.

Return to workstation. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Record data. Talk to patient. Exit patient room. Wash hands. Enter next patient room. Check vital signs. Record data. Exit patient room. Wash hands. Attend meeting. Take notes. Exit meeting. Return to workstation. Clock out.
Exit healthcare facility. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Add meat. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Place plate on table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Stand up. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in living room, watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Exit living room.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and watching TV in living room
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Watch TV. Change channel. Type on keyboard. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Stand up. Exit living room.

Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Breathe deeply. Remain still.
